simple.meaning: מְנוּחָה (mᵉnûwchâh) appears 22 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced in connection with kingship.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Judges, Ruth, and 8 more, beginning at Genesis 49:15. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as birth, family line, covenant, kingship, Israel.

definitions.short: repose or (adverbially) peacefully ; figuratively, consolation (specifically, matrimony ); hence (concretely) an abode
definitions.usage: comfortable, ease, quiet, rest(-ing place), still.
definitions.full: H4496. menuchah מְנֻחָה מְנוּחָה, noun feminine resting-place, rest ; — absolute ׳מ Micah 2:10 +, מְנֻחָה Gen 49:15 (but see below), 2Sam 14:17 ; suffix מְנוּחָתִי Psa 95:11 2 t., מְנוּחָתֶ֑ךָ 132:8 2Chr 6:41 (where read as in Psalms, for anomalous לְנוּחֶ֑ךָ MT), מְנֻחָתוֺ Isa 11:10 ; Zech 9:1 ; plural מְנוּחֹת Isa 32:18 , מְנֻחוֺת Psa 23:2 ; — 1 resting-place Micah 2:10 ; Num 10:33 (JE), Deut 12:9 (+ הַנַּחֲלָה ) so Psa 95:11 ( ׳י s resting- plural), compare 132:8 2Chr 6:41 (see above), Psa 132:14 ; Isa 66:1 (|| לִי תִּבְנוּ אֲשֶׁר בַּיִת ), compare מ ׳בֵּית וגו ׳לַאֲרוֺן 1Chr 28:2 ; also Isa 11:10 ; probably also Gen 49:15 (|| הָאָרֶץ טוֺב here is apparently substantive, ⅏ reads adjective טוֺבָה ; but read perhaps מְנֻחהֹ , his resting-place , from מָנוֺחַ , Ball Hpt Holz after ᵑ6 ); שַׁאֲנַנּוֺת מְנוּחֹת Isa 32:18 (+ מִבְטַחִים מִשְׁכְּנוֺת שָׁלוֺם, נְוֵה ); of ׳י s word Zech 9:1 ; resting-place on journey, in מ ׳שַׂר Jer 51:59 (Ew Gf Gie and others); figurative for security, assurance 2Sam 14:17 (taken from resting , equilibrium, of scale according to Klo). 2 rest, quietness , plural מְנֻחוֺת מֵי Psa 23:2 ; = refreshment Isa 28:12 (|| מַרְגֵּעָה ); rest (from enemies) = peace 1Kin 8:56 (compare 5:18 ), מ ׳אִישׁ 1Chr 22:9 a man of peace (compare הֵנִיחַ v b ); = relief from sorrow Jer 45:3 ; condition of rest and security attained by marriage Ruth 1:9 (= מָנוֺחַ 3:1 ). — ׳מ Judg 20:43 is perhaps proper name, compare GFM.

occurrences.englishText: He saw a resting place, that it was good,
They set forward from the Mount of Yahweh three days’ journey. The ark of Yahweh’s covenant went before them three days’ journey, to seek out a resting place for them.
for you haven’t yet come to the rest and to the inheritance which Yahweh your God gives you.
They surrounded the Benjamites, chased them, and trod them down at their resting place, as far as near Gibeah toward the sunrise.
May Yahweh grant you that you may find rest, each of you in the house of her husband.”
Then your servant said, ‘Please let the word of my lord the king bring rest; for as an angel of God, so is my lord the king to discern good and bad. May Yahweh, your God, be with you.’ ”
“Blessed be Yahweh, who has given rest to his people Israel, according to all that he promised. There has not failed one word of all his good promise, which he promised by Moses his servant.

Behold, a son shall be born to you, who shall be a man of peace. I will give him rest from all his enemies all around; for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness to Israel in his days.

Then David the king stood up on his feet, and said, “Hear me, my brothers, and my people! As for me, it was in my heart to build a house of rest for the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, and for the footstool of our God; and I had prepared for the building.
He makes me lie down in green pastures.
Therefore I swore in my wrath,
Return to your rest, my soul,
Arise, Yahweh, into your resting place,
“This is my resting place forever.
It will happen in that day that the nations will seek the root of Jesse, who stands as a banner of the peoples; and his resting place will be glorious.
to whom he said, “This is the resting place. Give rest to weary,” and “This is the refreshing;” yet they would not hear.
My people will live in a peaceful habitation,
Yahweh says,
‘You said, “Woe is me now! For Yahweh has added sorrow to my pain! I am weary with my groaning, and I find no rest.” ’

The word which Jeremiah the prophet commanded Seraiah the son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, when he went with Zedekiah the king of Judah to Babylon in the fourth year of his reign. Now Seraiah was chief quartermaster.
Arise, and depart!
A revelation.
